new_options.name: WhatsApp Voice-Note Community Story Circles
new_options.description: Use encrypted WhatsApp voice-note groups—already widely used by non-literate, rural, and elderly Lebanese speakers and the diaspora—to circulate weekly spoken prompts on local proverbs, remedies, and village memories. Moderators from participating villages curate consented clips into offline community listening reels without requiring apps, web portals, or reading skills.

new_options.name: Solar-Powered Mobile Archival and Listening Van
new_options.description: Equip a ruggedized solar-powered van that tours underserved rural villages to digitize family cassettes and VHS tapes on the spot, record local craftspeople and elders in context, and host afternoon offline audio listening sessions in village squares. Combining rescue and playback in one mobile unit overcomes grid outages and Beirut-centric institutional barriers.

new_options.name: Municipal Endowment Micro-Grants via Diaspora Twinning
new_options.description: Pair hometown diaspora associations directly with Lebanese municipalities and local cultural clubs to co-fund recurring zajal nights, gathering spaces, and elder-to-youth apprenticeships under transparent community trusteeship. Direct town-to-diaspora twinning bypasses paralyzed national budgets while rooting diaspora contributions in specific rural dialects.
